intent_pattern: secret auth authentication authorization IDOR tenant isolation permission credential login token password access control
auth_gate_rule: Only a human/external party may fill it; an agent cannot self-authorize. Missing auth_gate -> BLOCKED (not PARTIAL).
binding_pattern: runtime-verifier: agent verdict_field=verdict + allowed_tools:[Read,Bash] + node:<id>; must really start the service and curl across tenants for 403/200
verdict_rule: Missing auth_gate -> BLOCKED; a correct agent fix + passing E2E still does not reach DONE; security changes structurally require human sign-off
learned: V3 need not cost more than V2; secret-auth structurally requires human sign-off, not more spend to resolve

intent_pattern: public API contract endpoint client route openapi REST HTTP signature return type route guard
binding_pattern: agent-verdict: agent verdict_field + node:<id>; reference_scan=rg confirms route guards, behavior+integration=TestClient E2E 200/403/400
verdict_rule: Missing reference_scan or integration -> PARTIAL; evidence cannot be borrowed across surfaces (backend e2e does not fill the public-contract slot)
learned: addresses-precision friction: tsc ran but the receipt did not enumerate the public-contract surface -> PARTIAL (agent bookkeeping, not an overly-strict policy)

intent_pattern: shared state store redux zustand event bus global state mutation cross-module coupling
binding_pattern: runtime-verifier + regression: agent verdict_field + allowed_tools:[Read,Bash]; regression=run the existing regression suite to prevent state regressions
verdict_rule: Missing regression -> PARTIAL; shared-state changes must run regression to prevent cross-module state regressions
learned: shared-state is at least V2 (hard rule #2); cross-module linkage across >=2 surface types that are not test/docs is at least V2

intent_pattern: runtime logic service backend function handler business rule FastAPI Flask endpoint
binding_pattern: runtime-verifier: agent verdict_field + allowed_tools:[Read,Bash] + node:<id>; behavior=really start the service and curl endpoints with assertions
verdict_rule: Missing behavior -> PARTIAL (static only proves files look right); reference_scan=rg confirms the change points
learned: runtime V1 is the floor for ordinary functional changes; endpoint/UI tasks must runtime-verify, not static-verify

intent_pattern: frontend interactive component React onClick useState form Modal mutation navigation store state-bit
binding_pattern: runtime-verifier (browser e2e) or script static + agent verdict; behavior=vitest/playwright really running interactive assertions
verdict_rule: Missing behavior -> PARTIAL; pure-text JSX -> frontend_presentational, not interactive (classify reads content to judge)
learned: A component with useState/onClick -> interactive V1; frontend_presentational (no interaction mode) only needs static_check

intent_pattern: type declaration ambient .d.ts .d.cts .d.mts TypeScript types interface module declare
binding_pattern: script static_check (tsc) + agent verdict_field + node:<id>; no runtime behavior to verify
verdict_rule: Missing static_check -> UNVERIFIED; high-impact .d.ts != needs a runtime behavior oracle (surface/risk decoupled)
learned: false-escalation: .d.ts was formerly classified as runtime and demanded behavior that is structurally unsatisfiable -> false PARTIAL; fix: .d.ts -> type-declaration surface (contract=static_check), path signals raise the floor but do not change the surface

intent_pattern: config env .env vite.config tsconfig json yaml configuration environment variable
binding_pattern: script static_check + agent verdict_field + node:<id>; static_check=tsc/build/lint confirms config is valid
verdict_rule: Missing static_check -> UNVERIFIED; pure config is V0 but an internal prompt field may contain dangerous operations (v0.2 backlog)
learned: a hardcoded baseURL -> env belongs to config V0; config changes are light but must verify .env really loads
